podcast.body: Released in 2017, this album was described as "fantastic" and maintained a high minimum quality, despite the band's initial innovative formula having become more assimilated over the years. It featured "fantastic" collaborations, and there was significant anticipation for new material from Gorillaz. "el disco era fantástico y teníamos tanta hambre de un disco nuevo de Gorilla hace material de Gorilla y sigue teniendo una calidad mínima muy buena."

podcast.body: The fifth Gorillaz album, released on April 28, 2017, after a seven-year hiatus and a prolonged social media buildup. It featured numerous collaborators, with some notable artists declining to participate or having their contributions unused. "After seven long years, the fifth album was finally ready. Humans was released on April 28th, 2017 after a long, long buildup on social media."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album marked an important comeback for the band, representing a radical return to the winning formula that brought them fame in the early 21st century. It features enormous promotional spending, potentially the largest of the century, much of it covertly invested in digital channels like Facebook and YouTube, and offers easy independent pop mixed with trip-hop and hip-hop, focused on current affairs to appeal to the commercial audience the band had lost. "este disco sí hay algo por lo que destacan es porque vuelven radicalmente a esa fórmula ganadora que los hicieron tan famosos a primeros este siglo."
